```{r}
library(tidyverse)

train <- read_csv("data-train.csv") |>
  mutate(
    C_moment_2 = R_moment_2 - R_moment_1^2,
    sd_R = sqrt(C_moment_2),
    Re = factor(Re),
    Fr = factor(Fr)
  )
stopifnot(all(is.finite(train$sd_R)), all(train$sd_R > 0),
          all(train$St > 0))
```

## Explore SD and St

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
hist(train$sd_R, main = "SD", xlab = "SD")
hist(log(train$sd_R), main = "Log SD", xlab = "log(SD)")
hist(train$St, main = "St", xlab = "St")
hist(log(train$St), main = "Log St", xlab = "log(St)")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

## Compare log transformations using LOOCV


```{r}
log_formulas <- list(
  no_logs = sd_R ~ St + Re + Fr,
  log_SD = log(sd_R) ~ St + Re + Fr,
  log_St = sd_R ~ log(St) + Re + Fr,
  log_both = log(sd_R) ~ log(St) + Re + Fr
)

evaluate_sd <- function(formula, data) {
  log_response <- grepl("log", deparse(formula[[2]]), fixed = TRUE)
  predictions <- numeric(nrow(data))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(data))) {
    fit <- lm(formula, data = data[-i, ])
    pred <- predict(fit, newdata = data[i, , drop = FALSE],
                    rankdeficient = "NA")
    if (log_response) {
      correction <- mean(exp(residuals(fit)))
      pred <- exp(pred) * correction
    }
    predictions[i] <- pred
  }
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(predictions)))
  list(
    fit = lm(formula, data = data),
    predictions = predictions,
    RMSE = sqrt(mean((data$sd_R - predictions)^2)),
    MAE = mean(abs(data$sd_R - predictions)),
    negative_predictions = sum(predictions < 0)
  )
}

log_evaluations <- lapply(log_formulas, evaluate_sd, data = train)
log_comparison <- imap_dfr(log_evaluations, function(result, name) {
  tibble(model = name, RMSE = result$RMSE, MAE = result$MAE,
         negative_predictions = result$negative_predictions)
}) |>
  arrange(RMSE)
knitr::kable(log_comparison, digits = 4)

best_log_name <- log_comparison$model[1]
best_additive <- log_evaluations[[best_log_name]]$fit
best_log_name
```

## Diagnostics for the best additive model

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 7
summary(best_additive)
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(best_additive)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

## Compare interaction effects


```{r}
# Build the interaction formulas using the selected log combination.
y_term <- if (best_log_name %in% c("log_SD", "log_both")) "log(sd_R)" else "sd_R"
x_term <- if (best_log_name %in% c("log_St", "log_both")) "log(St)" else "St"
interaction_rhs <- c(
  additive = paste(x_term, "+ Re + Fr"),
  Re_Fr = paste(x_term, "+ Re * Fr"),
  St_Re = paste(x_term, "* Re + Fr"),
  St_Fr = paste(x_term, "* Fr + Re"),
  pairwise = paste0("(", x_term, " + Re + Fr)^2"),
  threeway = paste(x_term, "* Re * Fr")
)
interaction_formulas <- lapply(interaction_rhs, function(rhs) {
  as.formula(paste(y_term, "~", rhs))
})
interaction_evaluations <- lapply(interaction_formulas, evaluate_sd, data = train)
interaction_comparison <- imap_dfr(interaction_evaluations, function(result, name) {
  tibble(model = name, RMSE = result$RMSE, MAE = result$MAE,
         parameters = result$fit$rank,
         AIC = AIC(result$fit), BIC = BIC(result$fit),
         negative_predictions = result$negative_predictions)
}) |>
  arrange(RMSE)
knitr::kable(interaction_comparison, digits = 4)

best_interaction_name <- interaction_comparison$model[1]
final_sd <- interaction_evaluations[[best_interaction_name]]$fit
final_sd_predictions <- interaction_evaluations[[best_interaction_name]]$predictions
formula(final_sd)
```


## Final-model summary and diagnostics

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 7
summary(final_sd)
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(final_sd)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```


## Held-out predictions and largest errors

```{r}
sd_predictions <- train |>
  mutate(row_id = row_number(), predicted_SD = final_sd_predictions,
         absolute_error = abs(sd_R - predicted_SD))

ggplot(sd_predictions, aes(sd_R, predicted_SD, color = Fr, shape = Re)) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(x = "Observed SD", y = "LOOCV predicted SD") +
  theme_minimal()

sd_predictions |>
  slice_max(absolute_error, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  select(row_id, St, Re, Fr, sd_R, predicted_SD, absolute_error) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 4, caption = "Five largest LOOCV errors")
```


Among the additive models, logging both SD and St gives the lowest LOOCV RMSE
(about 5.99) and MAE (2.52). Keeping those transformations and adding a Re-Fr
interaction reduces RMSE to about 2.90 and MAE to 0.98, the lowest values among
the interaction candidates. The selected model is
`log(sd_R) ~ log(St) + Re * Fr`. It has no negative LOOCV predictions.

This suggests that the association between gravitational condition and SD
differs across Reynolds-number levels. The estimated log-St coefficient is
about 0.469, describing a positive adjusted association with SD; its slope is
shared across conditions in this model. These are model-based associations.

The Q-Q plot shows lower-tail departures, and residual plots flag observations
82, 87, and 30 for investigation. The scale-location plot also suggests that
residual spread is not fully constant. Keep all observations unless a data
error or scientific reason justifies exclusion. Model selection improves
predictive accuracy but does not remove these diagnostic limitations.
